compatibility_rows.resolution: Preserve exact model repository, revision, and snapshot.
Preserve explicit TRITON_ATTN and exact line-local backend marker proof.
Preserve exact TARGET_SITE PYTHONPATH and PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 for parent/child processes.
Filter prohibited CUDA stub paths before inheriting LD_LIBRARY_PATH; prepend governed target NVIDIA libraries and retain the real driver directory.
Remove inherited LD_PRELOAD before import probes and worker startup.
Use V5 process-tree/two-worker inspection with P4-style target-origin and CUDA-stub rejection requirements.
Keep the P5/P6 dual-worker GPU/port/resource envelope rather than copying P4 one-worker serving limits.
One P4 canary only: V4 prompt, repetition_penalty=1.1, UNCONSTRAINED output, exact-object validation; no A-F reselection.
Use request-attributable cached-prefix, computed-prefill, and prompt-token deltas; latency is secondary only.
Do not rely on namespace-only reset. Terminate worker, prove process/GPU/port release, restart with fresh identity, and prove zero-cache baseline.
Because V5 strips labels then sums names within each worker-local metrics endpoint, require exactly one served model per worker and snapshot both ports around every P6 route.
Route proof is transport completion plus target metric delta and zero non-target delta; model semantics are not route evidence.
Persist attempted/completed counters and stage checkpoints atomically before/after fallible route boundaries.
Benchmark trajectory requests remain zero in reconnaissance and successor qualification.

established_findings: P4 V2 and V5 share the governed model identity and TRITON_ATTN backend.
P4 V2 is the stronger native-library/environment basis because it filters CUDA stub paths and removes LD_PRELOAD.
V5 is the stronger P5/P6 behavior basis because it has dual-worker topology, typed route checkpoints, per-worker counters, metric attribution, and teardown proof.
Historical V4 P5 execution proves positive same-worker cache reuse and full-process restart reset.
Historical V4 P6 first diverged at worker-1 response-contract validation, not basic dual-worker startup.
P4 V2 selected case A, so successor P4 uses one case-A canary without repeating A-F.
Pinned vLLM 0.19.1 source confirms prefix-cache hit statistics are token based.
Successor P5 uses full process restart and therefore does not depend on namespace-only cache reset behavior.
implementation_invariants: Filter CUDA stub paths from inherited LD_LIBRARY_PATH.
Prepend governed target NVIDIA library directories.
Preserve exact TARGET_SITE PYTHONPATH for parent and child Python.
Preserve request logging disabled and raw prompt/output exclusion.
Use P4 case A: V4 prompt, repetition_penalty 1.1, unconstrained exact-object output.
Use full worker-process restart for P5 reset.
Capture both worker metrics before and after each P6 routed request.
Require target prompt-token delta > 0 and non-target prompt-token delta == 0.
Persist P6 attempted/completed counters before and after transport.
Keep maximum model requests at five and benchmark trajectories at zero.
